questions.question: If you feel tired while riding, what should you do?

options.text: Keep riding and hope you wake up.

questions.explanation: Do not ride when tired. On long trips, take a rest break every two hours to prevent fatigue.

questions.question: Why should motorcycle riders turn their heads to look over their shoulders before changing lanes?

options.text: Motorcycles have blind spots like other vehicles.
It helps you get other drivers' attention.
You should make eye contact with nearby drivers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Motorcycles have blind spots like other vehicles.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles have blind spots that mirrors cannot show. Always turn your head to check for vehicles in your blind spot before changing lanes.

questions.question: When should a rider use their mirrors?

options.text: When slowing down or stopping suddenly

questions.explanation: Check your mirrors when slowing down, stopping, at intersections, changing lanes, and turning.

questions.question: If your motorcycle starts to handle differently while riding, what should you do?

options.text: Pull over and check the tires.
Pull over and check the chain.
Pull over and check the windshield.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull over and check the tires.
questions.explanation: A change in how your motorcycle handles may mean a tire has failed. Pull over safely and check your tires.

questions.question: What type of sign is rectangular?
questions.explanation: Speed limit signs are rectangular with white backgrounds and black letters. Follow all rules shown on these signs.

questions.question: If you wait one hour after drinking one alcoholic drink, can you safely ride?

options.text: You cannot be arrested for drunk driving.
Alcohol will not affect your riding skills.
Alcohol effects may still be present.
You will be fine as long as you ride slowly.

questions.correctAnswerText: Alcohol effects may still be present.
questions.explanation: Your body removes about one drink per hour. However, alcohol can still build up in your system and affect your ability to ride safely.

questions.question: Should you use your headlight during the day?

options.text: No, never use it during the day.
Only use it when it is cloudy.
Use it only if you think it helps.

questions.explanation: Always keep your headlight on while riding, even during the day. This makes other drivers twice as likely to notice you.

questions.question: What do goggles protect when riding?

options.text: Your eyes, but not your face
Your face, but not your eyes
They are less effective than eyeglasses

questions.correctAnswerText: Your eyes, but not your face
questions.explanation: Goggles protect your eyes only. A face shield protects your entire face. Eyeglasses are not a good substitute for either.

questions.question: How should you position your feet when riding a motorcycle?

options.text: Keep them firmly on the footrests.
Keep them away from the controls.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep them firmly on the footrests.
questions.explanation: Place your feet firmly on the footrests to keep your balance. Do not drag them or point them down. Keep them near the controls so you can reach them quickly.

questions.question: How many brakes do most motorcycles have?
questions.explanation: Most motorcycles have one brake for the front wheel and one for the rear wheel. The front brake is stronger.

questions.question: When should you do a pre-ride inspection?
questions.explanation: Small problems on a motorcycle are more dangerous than on a car. Check your motorcycle before every ride to stay safe.

questions.question: Which of these is NOT protective clothing for a motorcycle rider?
questions.explanation: Safe riders wear a helmet, eye protection, a jacket, long pants, sturdy boots, and gloves.

questions.question: What is the best lane position?

options.text: The one that lets you travel the fastest
The one that allows you to draft off other vehicles
The one that allows other drivers to see you
The one that places you in other vehicles' blind spots

questions.correctAnswerText: The one that allows other drivers to see you
questions.explanation: The best lane position helps you see others and lets them see you. It keeps you away from wind blasts, blind spots, and hazards. It also discourages other drivers from sharing your lane and gives you an escape route if needed.

questions.question: What must you have when carrying a passenger on a motorcycle?

options.text: A seat large enough for two riders
No requirement for passenger protective clothing
A sticker on the brake light to warn other drivers

questions.correctAnswerText: A seat large enough for two riders
questions.explanation: Your motorcycle must have a seat designed for two riders. It should also have footrests for the passenger. Your passenger should wear the same protective gear you wear.

questions.question: What should you do when riding?

options.text: Scan the road ahead and watch for potential hazards
Focus on the controls and speedometer instead of the road
Not worry about hazards because they are rare
Look ahead but try not to look for hazards

questions.correctAnswerText: Scan the road ahead and watch for potential hazards
questions.explanation: Always look far ahead to spot possible dangers early. This helps you react to hazards before you reach them.

questions.question: What should you check during a pre-ride brake inspection?

options.text: The brakes make a loud squeaking noise
The brakes cause friction with the steering
Each brake can hold the motorcycle
Only the rear brake can hold the motorcycle

questions.correctAnswerText: Each brake can hold the motorcycle
questions.explanation: Test each brake lever separately before every ride. Make sure each one feels firm and keeps the motorcycle stopped when fully applied.

questions.question: What should a helmet do to provide the best protection?
questions.explanation: Choose a helmet that meets U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT) and state standards. It should fit snugly all around with no cracks, loose padding, or frayed straps.

questions.question: How often should you do a pre-ride inspection?
questions.explanation: Check your motorcycle thoroughly before every ride to prevent dangerous problems. Small mechanical issues are more serious on a motorcycle than on a car.

questions.question: What should you do if someone is tailgating you?

options.text: Ride on the shoulder of the road

questions.explanation: The safest response is to let the tailgater get ahead of you. Change lanes if you can do so safely and allow them to pass. Riding faster may make them follow you at a higher speed, which is more dangerous.

questions.question: What color are warning signs with black lettering?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black lettering or symbols. They alert drivers about upcoming road conditions.

questions.question: Motorcycle riding gloves are usually made of:
questions.explanation: Motorcycle gloves are usually made of leather. They improve your grip and protect your hands and fingers.

questions.question: When passing parked vehicles, riders should watch out for:

options.text: Cars pulling out of parking spaces.

questions.correctAnswerText: Cars pulling out of parking spaces.
questions.explanation: When passing parked vehicles, be careful. A car may suddenly pull away from the curb or leave a parking space.

questions.question: If a friend who has been drinking wants to ride their motorcycle, you should:

options.text: Tell them to use quiet roads.
Get other friends to convince them not to ride.

questions.correctAnswerText: Get other friends to convince them not to ride.
questions.explanation: Do not let someone ride if they have been drinking. Stop them from riding. Ask other friends to help talk them out of it.

questions.question: For best protection, jackets and pants should:

options.text: Cover your arms and legs completely.
Be loose and flap in the wind.
Cover only part of your arms and legs.

questions.correctAnswerText: Cover your arms and legs completely.
questions.explanation: Jackets and pants must cover your arms and legs completely for protection. They should fit snugly but allow you to move freely. Leather or synthetic materials offer the best protection in a crash.

questions.question: To help other drivers see you, wear:
questions.explanation: Wear bright colors so other drivers can see you. Bright clothes help you stay visible during the day and at night.
